literal: Every time reading, book's pleasure like, every time associating, good character possessors' friendship.
translation: The friendship of people with good character brings greater joy the more you associate with them, just as a good book brings greater pleasure the more you read it.
modern: நல்ல பண்புகளை உடையவர்களின் நட்பு, பழகப் பழக இன்பம் தருவது; அது நல்ல நூல்களைப் படிக்கப் படிக்க அவற்றின் பொருள் இன்பம் தருவதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet compares the friendship of noble people to the experience of reading a great book. Just as a good book reveals deeper meanings and gives more pleasure with every reading, true friendship grows richer and more joyful with continuous association. The parallel words 'naviltoṟum' (every time one reads) and 'payiltoṟum' (every time one associates) emphasize this continuous growth of joy.
